review.notes: Fresh main8da. Native Overview caps preview3 and only exposes View all in header, unlike existing RN remaining-count footer. Actual open records may have completed substeps and verbose cleanup receipts; explicit whole-goal completion/user-input must be reconciled by HQ, never inferred in UI. Distinguish source roster availability from goal status. Reuse canonical workspace grouping/multiline/AX fixture infrastructure; no new state enum or permission expansion. Ask HQ for verified live closure/blocker updates; no real answers, cleanup, runtime install, new release or workers. UI tests use synthetic data and actual in-process AX, separate physical mouse/VO/installed acceptance.
